correctness.rationale: For every order at least three and every initial set, a black line-graph vertex has exactly as many white neighbors as the sum of its two endpoint degrees in the remaining white-edge graph. A legal force removes a leaf edge using a white-isolated anchor. Thus no isolate blocks all first moves, and a cycle cannot lose its first edge. Conversely an isolated anchor allows successive deletion of every leaf of any white forest. Cayley tree counts and the labeled exponential formula then prove the complete polynomial and its extremal coefficients. A separately coded brute-force rule agrees with forest tests and a separate recurrence on all 33864 assignments for n=3..6. Unbounded correctness depends on the given proof, not enumeration.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: A threshold on the smallest cardinality neither determines membership among equal-cardinality sets nor the coefficients at other degrees. Conversely the newly proved forest-isolate criterion directly entails the scalar and is stronger for this restricted graph family. We claim this strengthening and its enumerative consequences only; a covering earlier all-set theorem would defeat originality if subsequently identified.

originality.rationale: The known zero-forcing number of the triangular graph (Eroh–Kang–Yi 2012, Proposition 3.5; earlier AIM 2008; and broader Fallat–Soltani 2016) is explicitly excluded from novelty. The claimed object is the collection of every forcing initial set and its complete size polynomial, reconstructed by a forest-isolate bijection. The published 2018 polynomial framework and 2015 positive-semidefinite Johnson-graph result do not imply this class-specific enumeration in the inspected material. The full 2008 Proposition 4.9 proof was checked; its scalar equality is already credited, but it does not classify all sets. Residual risk of differently indexed equivalence is documented; the search is not a uniqueness certificate.
residual_risks: The foundational 2008 Proposition 4.9 and relevant adjacent sections were inspected and establish only scalar rank/forcing equalities; a distinct pre-2008 enumeration could still have escaped identification.
Unindexed theses or later enumerations under edge zero-forcing, complement forest, or Johnson-graph terminology could be logically equivalent.
Bibliographic search absence does not establish absolute priority or novelty.

value.rationale: The natural full set-system of ordinary zero-forcing initial conditions on a classical line-graph family was not specified by prior scalar invariants. The exact forest criterion gives a compact structural recognition test, all coefficients of the forcing polynomial, the exact Cayley tree factor for optimal sets minimum sets, and an unbounded interval of mixed forcing/nonforcing cardinalities. This solves a whole-family, size-refined counting question rather than recomputing a scalar theorem; the missing source risk is recorded separately.
